content:
Perfection was not purchased, it was never a product on the Market, it is the reality that came into existence at the Ressurrection of Jesus Christ! He is Perfection, He is the life that never was, and yet has always been because He is before and after time. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Faith was a vehicle, it was never the destination, Faith was to get us somewhere and praise God, we are here now, that which is PERFECT is come. We don't faith for Perfection we are brought into it by the Power of the ressurected Christ.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a gift or an anointing. It is manifested life of the risen Christ, seen by all creation. It is the experience of Resurrection for all things Creation, the bringing of all things into how Jesus is. This is the Perfect Reality.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus did not come back to life, He ressurected; He became the reality of existence past death and the grave, never to die again. To defeat death is to go beyond it into the Perfect state, which is the ressurected Christ.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God does not want to restore you, He wants to bring you into Perfection. Restoration is the notion of going back to a place or position that was lost, Perfection is not a lost position, it is the reality of Christ in the Resurrection, it is His Reign over all things.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Many have known WHO Christ is, but have not come to the reality of HOW He is. How He is, is the power and manifestation of the Fullness of God, this is Perfection, all creation being brought into the experience of His fullness.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What Jesus has done in His death burial and resurrection is to set all Creation on a course of Life and Perfection. The sin of Adam set all things on a destruction course, from which thing could escape, Christ now pulls all things towards life and Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a potential, it is not something that you can become or attain, it is the reality and experience that is happening in the now. Christ is the reality of Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is a state, it is the full, unchanging measure of the stature of Christ! It is not just a better way of doing things, nor is it a higher demonstration of Power. Perfection is the visible manifestation of the risen Christ in a man that affects all Creation. It is the coming of the sons of God. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is what was wrought by the Glory of the Father in ressurecting Jesus Christ from death. God didn't bring Jesus back to life, He went past death, right through to the end of death and broke out into a state of Existence that has never been, Christ is now that reality beyond death. He has fulfilled all the claims of death for all creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

To say no one is perfect is to ridicule the Glorious work of the Father raising up Jesus from the dead. His death was perfect, His ressurrection brings all things into the state Perfection as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

System and ways of doing things are not permanent, once a system has served its purpose, it is left behind and made obsolete, there is a new and higher manifestation that comes into effect. The Spirit of God is revealing Perfection unto all creation. Welcome to the KINGDOM age.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Risen Christ does not need to be represented or pointed to, we not called to lead men to Him, in Perfection we become one with Him and manifest His Fullness to Creation. If one is still representing Christ, He doesn't have His Fullness. Jesus said he who has SEEN me has SEEN the Father.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus has no equal or comparison, to say HE is greater than other gods is to class Him with them, but the risen Christ is in a dimension all by Himself, He is existence, all things consist in Him, He is Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Anything that is in part needs to come into Perfection, God doesn't not do anything in steps or levels, He is Perfect and all His ways are Perfect, He is Fullness and all that He does He does in Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus doesn't have an anointing with which He functions, He doesn't need to ask God for Power, when you understand oneness with Him, you will stop asking for things that are in Part. Leaving the elementary principles of the Faith let us go onto Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is an expression of God that is revealed in Christ. It is not a part of Him. In the past we have been taught about the various ways in which God is revealed, in Perfection we do not see Him in Part, He is revealed in fullness for In Christ dwells the fullness of the Godhead bodily. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Don't stop at falling under the Power of God, for many that is the fullness of ministry, but the Holy Spirit revealed in His Fullness doesn't make anyone fall, rather we rise into the state as He is, Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What have seen and handled doesn't require Faith, it is the reality we experience and are walking in. This is God's desire for us to come into this experience with Him, don't remain on the believing level, there are higher dimension.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The wonders of Perfection cannot be found or seen in the system of belief it is built on seeing Jesus as He is, there cannot be Perfection without the reality and full Manifestation of Jesus the Resurrected Christ.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Adam all men died, in Jesus Life is manifested in all things. Jesus is the end of death, He is the Manifestation and experience of the Resurrection life for all Creation. He is Perfection in reality. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In past times it was revealed that the strongest bond is a covenant; covenants however get broken all the time and by nature a covenant always comes with a deal breaking clause. In Perfection we have a reality that cannot be broken or shaken, it is Oneness, being brought into His state the becoming how He is.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Religion deals with the state of man's spirit, connecting it to God, it works on his soul to renew him to live Godly, and it gives a promise of his body being redeemed in the future. In Perfection (the Resurrected Christ) the whole man is brought into the state of Christ instantly, spirit, soul, body and his environment. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection cannot be defined from the confines of time and space, it has no grid or alignment to the human or religious scope of knowledge. Perfection is only manifested in the Resurrected Christ, It is the Manifestation of How He is, our call therefore is to see Him and bring all Creation into this Truth.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a message it is the reality and experience of being in Christ's state. This is not a religious stance, or pattern of belief, it is the truth and Manifestation of God expressed in His Son's that liberates all creation from the bondage of Corruption. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a cause to live by, it is not a message to be preached, it is the Life and Glory of the risen Christ, it is the manifested, experiencial reality of being in the state of Christ. This is the time of Perfection, that which is PERFECT is Come.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The highest call of God is for us to be conformed into the image of His Son, the risen Christ. This is the Manifestation of the Son's of God, the redemption of all Creation, coming into the fullness of how He is... Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus Christ did not rise with any deficiencies, He is not lacking in any area, He is completely, in fact He is the Fullness of all things, He fills all in all. This is Perfection and we called to walk and manifest this reality, lacking nothing.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The proof of Perfection is not it's teaching, rather it is in the Manifestation of the fullness of the Son's of God, the silencing of the groanings of Creations. You can't preach Creation out of its bondage, it is only in the Manifestation of sons that it is liberated. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a work of a process or steps, it is something that one is instantly brought into by the risen Christ! Jesus was not raised from the dead by the Father in 7 steps, He did not go through a process to attain the resurrection, it was an instant work of that Mighty Power the full Manifestation of the Father's Glory! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is no fight in Perfection, All things are in the state where they belong to you, you are not striving with anything or anyone, we are not trying to overcome. Perfection is past death and corruption, Perfection is the state of being as the risen Christ is, it is the Manifestation of His reality to all creation.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The goal of the death, burial and resurrection of Jesus Christ was not just so that you can go to Heaven, it was to bring all creation into oneness with Himself. The is the result of the working of His mighty Power. All things brought into Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The fullness of our relationship with God is not expressed in the use of spiritual gifts, or high levels and demonstrations of power and authority, rather it is expressed in our oneness with Christ, to come into the reality of How He is, and manifest that to all creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God does not want people who would merely represent Him, that's because a representative still has his own characteristics and will. God's desire is to confirm us into the full image of His Son, so that we may be the Manifestation of Christ to all creation, the fullness of His character and life. This is Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

When God speaks of restoration He is not talking about going back to a place you where before something went wrong. Restoration speaks of bringing all things into the Perfect state, which is Christ. Christ is God's Original intent for all things.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is a Son of God by birth, not by adoption or maturing. In His ressurrection Christ was instantly brought into the fullness of the Perfection, He does not grow into it, He is in the state of Perfection, instantly. This is how the sons of God manifest, it is not through a maturing process, it is an instant appearing to all creation.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The greatness is in being and not just knowing, so many people just know, and they spend their time proclaiming to others what they know. Jesus didn't come to make us proclaimers of the glory of God; the Ressurrection life makes us manifest that it, it's not about confession it's about manifestation.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In this Kingdom age that we are in, it is not confession that will bring is into the Reality, it is seeing Jesus as He is and being conformed into that exact imagine. It's time for the Sons of God to Manifest in reality. No more seeing dimly in a mirror.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Don't base your life on your hard work, come to rest in the fullness of what Christ has done for you. Any area where you still need to labor to make it happen is a sign that you have not come in to rest, Jesus is the Totality of Rest in all spheres spiritual, emotional, physical etc. All things are brought into Perfection in Him.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is a realm all by Himself, He is the reality of Perfection to all creation. All things have there origin in Him, the Christ did not come to being at a point in time, Perfection is not a message for the time, It is the eternal state of being that has no beginning or end. Jesus is PERFECTION
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The power of the Resurrection is the power that brings all things into Perfection, it was only expressed once, and in that Work God the Father restored all things to Himself, Christ is the head of all Creation now in Him all things are brought into their fullness, this is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Heaven is not to be seen as a destination that one hopes to attain, Heaven is a place of Kingdom function from which we bring down the mandates of God and establish them to all creation. The restitution of all things, is not coming from people hoping to exit Earth but rather it is from people coming from Heaven and establishing it on Earth.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus came to give us life and that more abundantly, there is only one kind of life that He can give, that is eternal Immortal life. This life is on His terms not ours, to claim one has it but is still experiencing the ordinary life is wrong, it is not a life of Miracles, this is Perfection; an unchangeable, glorious life that manifests exactly how Jesus is.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In the past we have known life to be what one did before they die, many describe it as what happens in between birth and death, but the True definition of Life is the person of the Ressurected Christ! Jesus is Life past death the reality of an endless life, Christ is our life, the manifestation of God that bring all things into Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is the removal of anything that can fall or that can be shaken, Perfection is not about maintaining a thing, or keeping it standing. The reality of Chirst is that of one which is unshakable, He is the place of existence where things don't fail, fall or come to an end. Anything that can fall is not Perfect and is not of the Resurrected Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God's Original intent was not to take us to Heaven, He desire a people that manifest His Fullness and bring all creation into His state. This is your charge to be His manifestation unto Creation, the time is now. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not merely about Identity, it's about the actual state in which one exists. That is to say it's not about WHO you are, rather it's about HOW you are. It is walking and living in reality of I AM, the state in which God Himself is. Eternal and unchanging the permanent reality of How the risen Christ in. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus did not resurrect to show us that He could, He ressurected to show all creation the original purpose of God, to show the reality that God is drawing all Creation unto. This is the Perfect state of all things and Christ is the head. You are called to Perfection, it is God's Original intent for your life.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not the next level, it is not a higher revelation, it is the reality of the risen Christ! It is the expression of the fullness of God that Brings creation into rest. Perfection is a state, it is the Manifestation of how God is! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The goal of Christianity is being conformed into the image of the Son, that is Jesus the risen Christ. This is what we have been called to manifest and experience, this however does not happen by a process, Perfection is an instant work of the Ressurrection Power of God! We don't grow into it, rather we come into this Truth.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*
